integrity: The mathematical proof comprises a two-round game lemma, exact state-transition recurrence, exhaustive finite transition closure, complete palindrome witness census, and a distinct sharpness argument; verifiable with verify.py.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two named colours must both occur; the logic is full first-order logic of quantifier rank at most two. No extension to greater rank, larger alphabets or infinite structures is asserted.
title: Palindromic realizability of binary two-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé types
